chunks: From him, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, he raised it to Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'I shall teach you a supplication by which you will not forget the Quran.'

O Allah! Have mercy on me by causing me to neglect Your disobedience forever as long as You keep me alive, and have mercy on me from burdening myself with what does not concern me, and grant me a good perspective in what pleases You regarding me, and make my heart steadfast in memorizing Your Book as You taught me, and grant me to recite it in the manner that pleases You regarding me.

O Allah! Illuminate my sight with Your Book, expand my chest with it, gladden my heart with it, loosen my tongue with it, and employ my body with it, and strengthen me upon that and assist me on it, for there is no assistant upon it except You. There is no god except You.
He said: And some of our companions have reported from Walid ibn Sabih, from Hafs al-Awar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for memorizing and reciting the Quran correctly?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this supplication emphasizes the holistic integration of Quranic memorization with spiritual purity, linking the preservation of the text to the avoidance of sin and the purification of the heart. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the Quran as a living guide that illuminates the senses and strengthens the body for worship, ensuring recitation is not merely mechanical but deeply pleasing to God.
